{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Cimarron River Gas Pipeline''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Beaver Compressor Station area, Beaver County, Oklahoma to National Helium Gas Processing Plant, Seward County, Kansas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2017/12/14/2017-26929.txt|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

=== Cimarron Expansion Project ===
*'''Owner: '''Cimarron River Pipeline LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2017/12/14/2017-26929.txt|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''631 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2017/12/14/2017-26929.txt|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''49.3 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2017/12/14/2017-26929.txt|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2017<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2017/12/14/2017-26929.txt|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
